pages.text: $(l)Health$(): 180$(br)$(l)Damage$(): 10, every 1.29 s, range 5$(br)$(l)Speed$(): 4.72, flying$(br)$(l)Cost$(): 150 minerals, 125 vespene, 3 supply$(br)$(l)Build time$(): 43 s$(br2)$(o)StarCraft II numbers (LotV).$()

In the air it fires concord cannons at flying foes, with splash. $(l)Defender Mode$() (E): it stops and strikes ground units in its zone for 75 a shot; it cannot move or shoot air until it leaves the mode.

pages.text: $(l)Defender Mode$(): Immobile; hits ground units in its zone hard (75), cannot shoot air
